mentions.name: wsql
mentions.description: A GPU-accelerated query engine built with wgpu for cross-platform portability, implementing a modular pattern heavily inspired by the Sirius paper. Developed while working through the CMU 15-721 course.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm going through CMU 15-721 and building wsql[1]; a GPU-accelerated query engine. It uses wgpu for cross-platform portability and implements modular pattern, heavily inspired from Sirius[2] paper.
